words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.tr: phrase. 申请并获得一笔贷款；借贷
words.ex: He took out a loan to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他贷款买了一辆车。
words.en: To borrow money from a bank or financial institution.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.ex: He apologised for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而道歉了。
words.en: To say that you are sorry for something that you have done, especially something that has caused inconvenience or upset someone.

words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
words.ex_cn: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for what someone else has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.tr:
n. 法官；裁判；
v. 判断；评判；
words.ex: The judge announced the verdict in court.
words.ex_cn: 法官在法庭上宣布了判决。
words.en: A judge is a person who has the authority to decide questions brought before a court of law. To judge means to form an opinion or conclusion about something.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.ex: The narrator told the story in a calm voice.
words.ex_cn: 叙述者用平静的声音讲述了这个故事。
words.en: A narrator is a person who tells a story, or a person who speaks during a film or television program not as an actor but to describe or discuss the pictures being shown.

words.ex: The narration of the story was very clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的叙述非常清晰。
words.en: The act or process of telling a story or describing a series of events.

words.tr:
v. 敢说；
n. 打赌；赌注；
words.ex: I bet you didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 我敢说你不知道那件事。
words.en: If you bet on the result of a horse race, football game, or other event, you give someone a sum of money which they give you back with extra money if the result is what you predicted, or which they keep if it is not.

words.ex: They make a bet on who will win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他们打赌谁会赢比赛。
words.en: To make a bet means to agree to risk money on the result of an event or a competition, such as a horse race, in the hope of winning more money.

words.ex: The servant cleaned the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 仆人每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A servant is someone who is employed to work in another person's house, doing jobs such as cooking and cleaning.

words.ex: I thought he was late, but as a matter of fact, he is early.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上，他来早了。
words.en: You use as a matter of fact to introduce a statement that gives more details about what has just been said, or an explanation of it, or something that contrasts with it.

words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.tr:
v. 航行；驾（船）；
n. 帆；航行；航海；
words.ex: They sail to the island every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都乘船航行到那个岛。
words.en: To sail means to travel on water in a ship or boat, especially one that uses sails to catch the wind.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: He went to the consulate to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去领事馆办理签证。
words.en: A consulate is the place where a consul works, which is an official who is sent by their country to live in a foreign city in order to help other citizens from their own country and to represent their country's commercial interests.

words.ex: He dare not speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you dare to do something, you are brave enough to do it, even though it may be dangerous or shocking or may cause trouble for you.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.tr: n. 采矿；采矿业； v. “mine”的现在分词；
words.ex: Mining is an important industry in this region.
words.ex_cn: 采矿是这个地区的重要产业。
words.en: Mining is the process of extracting minerals and other materials from the earth.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.ex: To be honest, I don't like this food.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这种食物。
words.en: used when you are telling someone what you really think

words.ex: You ought to finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你应当在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: You use 'ought' to indicate that it is morally right or advisable for someone to do something, or to indicate that it is probable that something is true or will happen.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: The cat is beneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: In or to a lower position than someone or something, under someone or something.

words.ex: They decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定把会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone something means to arrange for it to take place at a later time than was originally planned.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐的歌曲。
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.ex: He wants to pursue his dream of becoming a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他想追求成为作家的梦想。
words.en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

words.ex: It is your duty to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成你的作业是你的职责。
words.en: A duty is a task or action that someone is required to perform.

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: The tailor made a new suit for the man.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝为这位男士做了一套新西装。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially suits, jackets, and trousers, that fit individual customers. As a verb, to tailor means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 以……的方式；以……的态度；以……的风度
words.ex: He speaks in a quiet manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以安静的方式说话。
words.en: In a way that is described by the preceding word or phrase.

words.ex: He went downstairs to get a drink.
words.ex_cn: 他下楼去拿饮料。
words.en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

words.ex: He walked up the stair to the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯到了二楼。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.ex: He stepped aside to let the bus pass.
words.ex_cn: 他走到一旁，让公交车通过。
words.en: If you move something aside, you move it to one side of you, usually because it is in the way.

words.tr:
v. 皱眉；蹙额
n. 皱眉；蹙额
words.ex: He frowns when he hears bad news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到坏消息时会皱眉。
words.en: If you frown, you bring your eyebrows together so that there are lines on your face above your eyes, often because you are annoyed or worried.

words.tr: phrase. 如果是那样的话；在那种情况下
words.ex: He didn't bring his book; in that case, I'll lend you mine.
words.ex_cn: 他没带书；那样的话，我借给你我的。
words.en: If that is the situation, then...

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.ex: He is tired, and indeed he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，的确很快就睡着了。
words.en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

words.ex: His temperature is normal.
words.ex_cn: 他的体温正常。
words.en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

words.tr: adj. 愿意的；乐意的； v. “will”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is willing to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are happy to do it if it is needed.

words.tr: phrase. 愿意做某事；乐意去做某事
words.ex_cn: 她愿意帮助你完成你的项目。
words.en: To be ready and eager to do something.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He is an ambassador to France.
words.ex_cn: 他是驻法国的大使。
words.en: An ambassador is an official envoy, especially a high-ranking diplomat who represents a state and is usually accredited to another sovereign state or to an international organization as the resident representative of their own government or sovereign or appointed for a special and often temporary diplomatic assignment.

words.tr: adj. 上流社会的；中学三四年级的
words.ex: She was born into an upper-class family.
words.ex_cn: 她出生在一个上流社会的家庭。
words.en: Belonging to or characteristic of the upper class.

words.tr: phrase. 上层阶级；社会地位和财富最高的阶层
words.ex: The upper class often has access to exclusive social clubs and events.
words.ex_cn: 上层阶级通常可以进入专属的社交俱乐部和活动。
words.en: The upper class refers to the group of people at the top of a social hierarchy, often distinguished by wealth, education, and influence.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.tr: v. “say”的现在分词；说； n. 谚语；警句；
words.ex: He is saying goodbye to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向朋友们道别。
words.en: A short, well-known expression that states a general truth or gives advice.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.
